high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a music player interface on a smartphone. The song currently playing is "Believer" by Imagine Dragons from their album "Evolve." The album cover is displayed prominently in the center of the screen, featuring a colorful light beam with a silhouette of a person standing at the end of it, set against a dark background. The top of the screen shows the time as 12:30 and the battery level at 31%. There are also icons for Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and airplane mode. On the left side of the screen, there is a vertical menu with options: Media output
